pages.text: Craft an Iron Hook as soon as you have iron. It's one of the best early-game items in the pack.$(br2)Shoot it with right-click. You'll pull toward whatever it hits. If you're falling, shoot the wall — you'll hang. Shoot the ceiling — you'll hang from it.

$(bold)Tiers:$()$(br)Iron Hook — basic, gets you around$(br)Diamond Hook — faster pull speed$(br)Ender Hook — fastest, longer range$(br2)$(bold)Multiple hooks:$() If you fire two hooks into different walls, you hover at their midpoint. Useful for bridging gaps or staying in position for ranged combat.
Iron + sticks. Upgrade to Diamond and Ender versions the same way with better materials.
